description: Scores a company's HR readiness for stablecoins, pay transparency and AI rules on 10 questions (jobs, pay, payroll, pay transparency, AI accountability, pipeline, risk talent, structure, evaluation, skills). Give answers as 10 digits in question order: 2 = yes, 1 = partly, 0 = no (e.g. 2121011012). Returns the score out of 20, the band (0-7 Exposed, 8-14 Building, 15-20 Ready) and an action list with the No answers first. Call with no answers to get the questions. Source: https://borbur.net/tools/digital-money-readiness-check/

answers.description: 10 digits, each 0, 1 or 2, in question order (optional)
